title: Battle.net launcher data
whyItMatters: The per-user Battle.net folder holds the launcher config and cache. It shows which Blizzard account was signed in on this machine.
source: Battle.net.config in %APPDATA%/Battle.net (Windows Report) and Blizzard Support article 34719 for the machine-wide ProgramData copy
notes: Only the per-user roaming folder is matched. The machine-wide C:/ProgramData/Battle.net copy is not covered. Config files are never parsed.
